display.name: Supernatural Expert
display.description: Traffic, latency, cost, judge verdicts, and viewer feedback, read from the spans the app already sends.

display.name: Questions answered
display.description: Every agent run, and the subset of them a viewer asked in the chat.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS x, count(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'invoke_agent supernatural-expert') AS agent_runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'chat turn') AS chat_turns FROM records WHERE span_name IN ('invoke_agent supernatural-expert', 'chat turn') GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

display.name: Latency
display.description: How long a whole turn takes, against how much of it is one model call.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS x, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'invoke_agent supernatural-expert') AS turn_p50, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) FILTER (WHERE span_name = 'invoke_agent supernatural-expert') AS turn_p95, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE span_name LIKE 'chat gpt-%') AS model_p50 FROM records WHERE span_name = 'invoke_agent supernatural-expert' OR span_name LIKE 'chat gpt-%' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

display.name: Viewer feedback
display.description: Thumbs recorded under the chat turn they judge.

spec.query: SELECT CASE WHEN attributes->>'thumbs_up' = 'true' THEN 'Thumbs up' ELSE 'Thumbs down' END AS thumb, count(*) AS clicks FROM records WHERE attributes->>'logfire.feedback.name' = 'thumbs_up' GROUP BY thumb ORDER BY thumb

display.name: Judge verdicts
display.description: Percentage of judged answers passing each measure. Relevant and supported are the model judge; retrieved is whether search reached the labelled document.

spec.query: SELECT measure, round(100.0 * sum(passed) / count(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM (SELECT 'relevant' AS measure, CASE WHEN attributes->'assertions'->'relevant'->>'value' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS passed FROM records WHERE span_name = 'case: {case_name}' UNION ALL SELECT 'supported', CASE WHEN attributes->'assertions'->'supported'->>'value' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM records WHERE span_name = 'case: {case_name}' UNION ALL SELECT 'retrieved', CASE WHEN attributes->'assertions'->'retrieved'->>'value' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM records WHERE span_name = 'case: {case_name}') GROUP BY measure ORDER BY measure

display.name: Model cost
display.description: Dollars per bucket, split by model, from the cost Logfire puts on every model call.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS x, attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model, sum((attributes->>'operation.cost')::double) AS cost FROM records WHERE span_name LIKE 'chat %' AND attributes->>'operation.cost' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x, model ORDER BY x

display.name: Tokens and cost by model
display.description: What each model was asked to read and write, and what that came to.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model, count(*) AS calls, sum((attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')::double)::bigint AS input_tokens, sum((attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens')::double)::bigint AS output_tokens, round(sum((attributes->>'operation.cost')::double), 4) AS cost FROM records WHERE span_name LIKE 'chat %' AND attributes->>'operation.cost' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost DESC
